title: Branch Operations Memo: Free-Storage Extension After a Late Shipment — Factory Production Orders
content:
**Memo.** For Factory Production Orders, a late-shipment extension lengthens the free storage period at the branch warehouse by the full weeks late recorded on the on-time guarantee credit the order earned:

| Full weeks late recorded on the earned credit | Free storage period lengthened by |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 14 calendar days |
| 1 or 2 | 7 calendar days |
| no earned guarantee credit on the order | no extension |

## Records read

The on-time guarantee credit entries on the order's milestone records; the full weeks late are the weeks recorded on the earned credit.

## Edges (hypothetical)

- A credit recording 2 full weeks late: 7 calendar days. A credit recording 3: 14 calendar days.
- An order that shipped late but carries no earned guarantee credit on its records: no extension.

## Effect on billable days (hypothetical)

An order with a 30-day free storage period and a credit recording 4 full weeks late has that period lengthened to 44 calendar days after branch delivery.
